content.comment_body: Hello all! I am using the [product_name] standalone, without the [product_name] basic module. I want to set up an event so that output Q1 changes state (either 0 or 1). What is the required message text format for this? Appreciate your help! Regards, [user_name]
The syntax for Q1 is: ON = Passwort;OUTPUT=O1,1 OFF = Passwort;OUTPUT=O1,0. For Q2: ON = Passwort;OUTPUT=O2,1 OFF = Passwort;OUTPUT=O2,0.
